title: Category Detail
description: Drill from category to subcategory to subdivision. Each selector narrows the next, so Subdivision only lists what the chosen subcategories contain. Trend against its own average, how often versus how much, where it happens, and how purchases are spread.

list.name: account
list.label: Accounts
list.query: SELECT name FROM accounts ORDER BY name

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT name FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY name

list.name: subcategory
list.label: Subcategory
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT roll2 FROM v_spending WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) ORDER BY 1

list.name: subdivision
list.label: Subdivision
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT roll3 FROM v_spending WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Total Spending
panels.description: Spending in the current selection over the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(outflow) AS "Total" FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

SELECT count(*) AS "Transactions" FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

panels.title: Share of Spending
panels.description: What portion of all spending in range this selection accounts for.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * sum(outflow) FILTER (WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[])))
             / nullif(sum(outflow), 0), 1) AS "Share"
FROM v_spending
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))

panels.title: Monthly Spend vs. Average
panels.description: The flat line is the average of the months shown, so every bar reads as above or below your own normal.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', posted_on) AS month, sum(outflow) AS spend
    FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       spend AS "Spend",
       round(avg(spend) OVER (), 2) AS "Average month"
FROM monthly ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average Transaction
panels.description: Mean size of a single purchase here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(outflow), 2) AS "Average" FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

panels.title: Subcategories
panels.description: Anything tagged only at the top level shows as "(unspecified)", so the bars still add up to the total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT roll2 AS subcategory, sum(outflow) AS spend
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Median transaction
panels.description: Half of purchases are smaller than this. An average well above it means a few large purchases carry the selection.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY outflow)::numeric, 2)
           AS "Median"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

panels.title: Average Month
panels.description: Divided by the months that actually have data in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(outflow)
             / nullif(count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', posted_on)), 0), 2)
           AS "Average month"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

panels.title: Transactions per month
panels.description: How often, as opposed to how much.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('month', posted_on)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       count(*) AS "Transactions"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average Transaction Size
panels.description: Rising here with a flat count is a price change, not a habit change.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('month', posted_on)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       round(avg(outflow), 2) AS "Average transaction"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Subdivisions
panels.description: The deepest level. "(unspecified)" means the transaction was tagged higher up the tree than this.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT roll3 AS subdivision, sum(outflow) AS spend
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Average & Total by Weekday
panels.description: Average purchase size and total per weekday.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(posted_on, 'Dy')   AS day,
       round(avg(outflow), 2) AS "Average transaction",
       round(sum(outflow), 2) AS "Total"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1, extract(isodow FROM posted_on)
ORDER BY extract(isodow FROM posted_on)

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', posted_on), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month",
       count(*)               AS "Transactions",
       sum(outflow)           AS "Total",
       round(avg(outflow), 2) AS "Average",
       min(outflow)           AS "Smallest",
       max(outflow)           AS "Largest"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Categories Geographically
panels.description: The selected categories only, so you can see where one kind of spending happens. Markers are sized and shaded by total spend; a place is one marker however often you go. Only transactions carrying coordinates appear.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.latitude,
       l.longitude,
       coalesce(mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.merchant),
                max(l.label), 'Unknown') AS place,
       max(l.city)       AS city,
       sum(v.outflow)    AS spend,
       count(*)          AS visits,
       max(l.popularity) AS popularity
FROM v_spending v
JOIN locations l ON l.id = v.location_id
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
  AND l.latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.id, l.latitude, l.longitude
ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.title: Transaction Size Spread
panels.description: How purchases are distributed, which an average hides: two clusters mean two different habits sharing one category.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outflow AS "Transaction" FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))

SELECT coalesce(merchant, '(no merchant yet)') AS "Merchant",
       count(*)               AS "Visits",
       sum(outflow)           AS "Total",
       round(avg(outflow), 2) AS "Average",
       to_char(max(posted_on), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Last seen"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT to_char(posted_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
       account     AS "Account",
       coalesce(merchant, description) AS "Merchant",
       coalesce(category_path, 'Uncategorized') AS "Category",
       outflow     AS "Amount"
FROM v_spending WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
ORDER BY outflow DESC LIMIT 30
